# Version 4.154.0 (Unreleased)
> **Skia m154 and Graphite**

> **API changes** · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.400/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.154.0 updates to Skia m154 and includes Graphite bindings for modern GPU backends. It carries forward asynchronous pixel readback, Vulkan Silk.NET package support, native symbol improvements, and lifetime fixes. Linux font fallback can select a different face after the m153 engine update.

## Breaking Changes

- **Linux font fallback may select a different face** — Skia now tries FcFontMatch before the previous FcFontSort fallback path. Applications that depend on an exact fontconfig fallback face may see different glyphs or text metrics; specify an explicit family and style, or bundle a typeface, when selection must be deterministic.

## Engine

- **Skia updated through milestone m154** — The bundled rendering engine advances through the m151, m152, and m153 updates to Skia m154, including upstream Chromium stability fixes. ([#4537](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4537), [#4538](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4538), [#4568](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4568), [#4651](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4651), [#4808](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4808), [#4826](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4826), [#4927](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4927), [#4945](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4945))

## API Surface

- **Graphite GPU backend bindings** — New bindings expose Graphite for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn, enabling managed applications to work with Skia's newer GPU architecture. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968))
- **Asynchronous pixel readback** — SKImage and SKSurface gain backend-neutral asynchronous RequestReadPixels support for reading pixels without blocking the rendering path. ([#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545))

## Bug Fixes

- **Native pixel-source lifetimes protected** — SKRegion span iteration and SKPixmap subsets or derived pixmaps now retain their native sources, preventing use-after-free failures. ([#4355](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4355), [#4558](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4558))
- **Raster image allocation and runtime-effect cleanup fixed** — Raster-image creation no longer leaks its pixel buffer on failure, and resetting runtime-effect uniforms disposes the previous uniform buffer. ([#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455), [#4783](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4783))
- **Reduced allocations in common managed operations** — Saving SKData, decoding null-terminated text, formatting four-byte tags, and using runtime-effect uniforms avoid unnecessary allocations and lookup overhead. ([#4498](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4498), [#4512](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4512), [#4550](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4550), [#4630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4630), [#4752](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4752))

## Platform

- **Vulkan Silk.NET packages restored** — The SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package is again produced alongside the existing Vulkan support. ([#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527), [#4841](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4841))
- **Nano Server gains FreeType font support** — Native packages use FreeType on Nano Server so font rendering is available on that Windows container target. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280))
- **Apple native symbol packages generated** — Apple native packages now include generated symbols to improve diagnosis of native crashes. ([#4846](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4846))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.400

HarfBuzzSharp avoids a defensive feature-array copy during shaping and fixes disposal of non-memory-backed stream assets used to create HarfBuzz blobs.
